description: This file defines the DecodingEventStreamIterator class, which implements an iterator to decode and validate binary-encoded event streams in AWS SDK for PHP. It handles parsing headers, prelude, event payloads, and integrity checks within AWS event stream protocols.

classes.name: DecodingEventStreamIterator
classes.description: An iterator class that decodes, validates, and iterates over binary-encoded AWS event streams, providing individual events for processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a stream of binary event data and prepares it for iteration.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current event data being parsed.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current position index of the iterator.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next event in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream and begins parsing from the start.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks whether the current position is valid within the stream.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses headers from a header byte array, returning key-value pairs.

methods.name: parsePrelude
methods.description: Parses the message prelude, including length fields and CRC checksum, verifying data integrity.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Decodes a single event from the stream, including headers and payload, with validation.

methods.name: readAndHashBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream and updates the hash context for integrity verification.

methods.name: decodeBooleanTrue
methods.description: Decodes a boolean true value.

methods.name: decodeBooleanFalse
methods.description: Decodes a boolean false value.

methods.name: uintToInt
methods.description: Converts unsigned integers to signed integers based on size.

methods.name: decodeInt8
methods.description: Decodes an 8-bit signed integer from the stream.

methods.name: decodeUint8
methods.description: Decodes an 8-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: decodeInt16
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit signed integer.

methods.name: decodeUint16
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: decodeInt32
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit signed integer.

methods.name: decodeUint32
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: decodeInt64
methods.description: Decodes a 64-bit signed integer.

methods.name: decodeUint64
methods.description: Decodes a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: unpackInt64
methods.description: Unpacks an 8-byte sequence into a 64-bit integer with support for PHP versions.

methods.name: decodeBytes
methods.description: Decodes a byte array of specified length.

methods.name: decodeString
methods.description: Decodes a string of specified length.

methods.name: decodeTimestamp
methods.description: Decodes a timestamp value (milliseconds since epoch) into a DateTime object.

methods.name: decodeUuid
methods.description: Decodes a UUID value into a standard UUID string format.
